context: M24 o2. (Nick.) Herald Square lunch counter. Calloway slides a single typed page across.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: Mr. Varelas. Insurance fraud in a brownout. Lieutenant's men on the corner. Photographs.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: Testify against Lisle, and the insurance matter becomes a misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: You're asking me to sell my lawyer.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: I'm asking you to stop being his merchandise. The offer expires in September. So do I.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Where do I sign? No. Where do I read? This time I read first.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: Every page. I'll wait. I have a budget for coffee.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I came here with nothing. I'll leave my own way. Good afternoon.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: Then I'll see you in a courtroom, Mr. Varelas. On the wrong side.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Everybody gets paid. Today I found out what I cost.
